Who it is for

Candidates who want current affairs in a form they can revise rather than re-read.

Buy it if

You prefer one monthly book over tracking the news yourself every day.

Avoid it if

You already follow a daily source - adding a second one usually costs time, not marks.

How to use it

Read the issue when it arrives, then revisit only its question set the month after.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • Facts arranged for recall rather than for reading
  • Practice questions at the end of each issue

Cons

  • Monthly - one skipped issue and you fall behind
  • A second source if you already follow the daily news
